I will be arriving in Paris on Sunday. Can you please provide me the the restaurant which serves French cuisine that open on Sunday? Recommend me the restaurant with the best rating and reviews.
            Tell me the restaurant name, rating, address, and the operating hours.

```python
def get_french_cuisine_restaurant():
    # Get all restaurants in Paris
    all_restaurants = get_all_restaurants_in_city("Paris")
    
    # Get the names of all restaurants
    restaurant_names = [restaurant["name"] for restaurant in all_restaurants]
    
    # Get the cuisine type of all restaurants
    cuisine_types = get_cuisine_type_for_restaurants(restaurant_names)
    
    # Filter restaurants that serve French cuisine
    french_cuisine_restaurants = [name for name, cuisine in cuisine_types.items() if cuisine == "French"]
    
    # Get the rating and reviews of French cuisine restaurants
    ratings_and_reviews = get_rating_reviews_for_restaurants(french_cuisine_restaurants)
    
    # Get the address of French cuisine restaurants
    addresses = get_restaurants_address(french_cuisine_restaurants)
    
    # Get the operating hours of French cuisine restaurants
    operating_hours = check_restaurant_opening_hours(french_cuisine_restaurants)
    
    # Find the restaurant with the best rating and reviews
    best_restaurant = max(ratings_and_reviews, key=lambda x: ratings_and_reviews[x])
    
    # Print the name, rating, address, and operating hours of the best restaurant
    print("Restaurant Name:", best_restaurant)
    print("Rating:", ratings_and_reviews[best_restaurant])
    print("Address:", addresses[best_restaurant])
    print("Operating Hours:", operating_hours[best_restaurant])

```
